name: h1-links-renderer

commands.cmd: Get-ChildItem -Force | Select-Object Name; Write-Output "---package.json---"; Get-Content package.json -Raw

rg -l "ILinkProvider|IBufferRange|interface ILink" node_modules/@xterm/xterm/typings/xterm.d.ts; Write-Output "==="; rg -n "interface ILinkProvider|interface ILink\b|interface IBufferRange|interface IBufferLine|isWrapped|translateToString|getLine\(" node_modules/@xterm/xterm/typings/xterm.d.ts
rg -n "export interface IDisposable|interface IDisposable|export declare" node_modules/@xterm/xterm/typings/xterm.d.ts | Select-String -Pattern "IDisposable|IBufferLine|IBufferRange|ILink"

rg -n "^declare module|^  export interface IDisposable|^namespace|^declare namespace" node_modules/@xterm/xterm/typings/xterm.d.ts | Select-Object -First 20; Write-Output "---head---"; Get-Content node_modules/@xterm/xterm/typings/xterm.d.ts -TotalCount 20

- `src/renderer/Terminal/links/detectLinks.ts` (+ test, 27 tests) — pure `detectLinkCandidates`: URLs/mailto, drive/UNC/`~`/`.`/`..`/relative/bare paths, quoted paths with spaces, `:12`/`:12:5`/`(12)`/`(12,5)` suffixes, balanced-paren URLs, trailing-punctuation trim, 2000-char/40-candidate caps, negatives (versions, `e.g.`, `a/b`, `3.14`, `12:30:45`).
